introTitle: A life devoted to sacred knowledge
introText: For more than three decades, Uzthaz Rasheed Hajjul Akbar has dedicated himself to the study and teaching of the Islamic sciences — from Qur’ānic exegesis and Hadīth to jurisprudence and spiritual refinement. His work bridges the depth of classical scholarship with the questions of contemporary life, serving the Muslim community of Sri Lanka and beyond with clarity, patience and care.
pullQuote: Seek knowledge from the cradle to the grave.
pullQuoteCite: A guiding principle of the Uzthaz’s teaching
